limitations: This is a three-case live behavior diagnostic, not a benchmark, score, confidence interval, or provider leaderboard.
Strict computer_use capture succeeded, but pixel-level locate and interaction were not supported by the active OpenAI subscription source; GEODE stopped instead of performing an unverified action.
The successful browser UI case used the provider-safe Playwright DOM path, not computer_use visual grounding.
The primary answers used Codex OAuth subscription, but the complete lifecycle also used one GLM PAYG auxiliary call per case after the primary session.
Raw session records, provider reasoning, runtime logs, local paths, and Slack workspace/channel identities remain withheld.
